paragraphs: Being willing to trace several documents across the same parcel of land and to record the document dates, the registered subject and the source clearly is a signal that this is worth experiencing. The work requires sustained reading and checking, and does not end as soon as one result with a matching name is found.

Check the deadline, the search scope and the restrictions carefully. Repeated searches within a short time may still come across missing records; when a contradiction appears, the basis and the unknowns must be stated rather than a definite conclusion written to keep up with progress.

First distinguish record searching, title document examination and abstract handover. These may involve different people working together, and the authority actually to determine title, process registration or make an insurance commitment is confirmed by jurisdiction and role, not presumed from the occupational title.

Start with the original E1 document index: read only the fictional parcel records P14 and P41, the D1 to D4 records and the deadline, list the questions and write the abstract. No real property files, customer material, paid databases or legal advice are needed.
How do you judge whether you are willing to do title record work?

Observe whether you can separate parties with the same name, different parcels and document dates, and match every sentence of the abstract back to the original record. Liking law or real estate can be a starting point, but checking details repeatedly, communicating the evidence scope and keeping the unknowns closer matches the daily tasks.
The practice on this page is not legal advice, a title insurance commitment, a registration licence or a hiring test, and the answers cannot be used in a real transaction.

Specific signals include keeping the document numbers and dates, being able to trace the source of a sentence in the abstract, checking the identifier even when the subject looks similar, and updating only the judgements affected after a revision. Faced with a deadline and limits on the material scope, being willing to put specific questions to the responsible person rather than explaining a failed search as an absence of problems.

Signals that call for caution include skipping the limiting conditions, merging different parcels, copying an automatic abstract without going back to the original text, or treating access to a database as authority for legal confirmation. Concerns about sitting for long periods, time pressure, repeated reading and counter communication should be judged together with the specific role, and personality type is not used to rule someone out.

Keep the E1 first version, the E2 revision and the source cross-reference table, observe whether you are willing to check again, and choose a real role to learn about the material scope, the re-checking responsibility and the training. The paper experience offers exploration clues and does not prove that you can handle a real title dispute.

The United States O*NET-SOC23-2093.00 covers real estate record searching, title examination and legal or insurance document abstracts. Clients may be law firms, real estate agencies and title insurance companies; task authority varies with jurisdiction and organisation, and it is not automatically the same as a registration authority role in China.

Input starts with the search request, including the parcel description to be searched, party names, record categories and the period. Clarify the search object and the deadline first, and do not merge records just because the address is close or the name is the same.

Check documents such as mortgages, liens, judgments, easements, plats, maps, contracts and agreements. The abstract must keep the source and the specific restrictions, since omitting one condition may change how a reader understands it; this page does not judge the effect of a real document.

During the search, compile the list of legal documents that apply to the same land and buildings and copy or abstract the relevant records. The search list is related to a professional title examination, but finding a document is not the same as confirming clear title.

Check the correspondence between the legal description, the rights holders and the restrictions, and prepare a report on the encumbrances found. Matters needing further handling go to people with the corresponding duties to determine, and the practice reader does not give release or transfer conclusions.

Communicate record problems with real estate staff, lenders, buyers and sellers, surveyors and court staff. State this matter's problem, the document number and the source clearly; communication and material organisation authority does not automatically include legal adjudication or registration decisions.

The O*NET context highlights accuracy, sitting, email and telephone use, daily time pressure and the consequences of error. A group description is not the working hours of every organisation or an individual fit diagnosis, and the actual workload and re-checking mechanism need to be checked.

Deliverables include the search list, document abstracts, a statement of restrictions and traceable update records. O*NET also lists tasks such as title insurance commitments, policies and closing documents, but whether these are actually taken on and whether they may be issued must be confirmed against the specific role and regulations.

The following divides record searching and title document examination and abstracts into two task understanding lines. They may overlap, the steps are an editorial arrangement, and they are not a uniform process for all organisations or a legal procedure guide.
Record searching and indexing
Read the request → check the parcel and period → search the specified records → record the source → identify missing items → hand over the search list
A search list with the object, period, document numbers and sources, plus the open items
Document examination and abstracts
Check the object → compare the documents → organise the time relationships → mark the encumbrance restrictions → refer for professional re-check → keep the abstract versions
Abstracts that can be traced back to the original records, a statement of restrictions and the items awaiting professional confirmation
Shared work foundation
Reading documents · object identification · chronological ordering · source records · restriction statements · re-check communication
Searching and examination abstracts: how do the inputs, outputs and responsibilities differ?

The search line focuses on finding and marking the material according to the request; the examination abstract line further checks the relationships between documents and the restrictions. Both require recording sources and unknowns, and the actual professional judgement and issuing authority are set by role and jurisdiction; completing an index does not mean the title is valid.
Core purpose
Find the records relevant to the object and period according to the request, and produce a traceable list of material.
Check the document descriptions and relationships, and write the relevant title or insurance details into an abstract with stated limits.
Main objects and basis
The search request, the parcel description, the parties, and public or permitted private records.
Mortgages, contracts, judgments, easements, plats and other relevant documents and the actual rules.
Core process
Determine the scope, find the records, mark the document sources and list what was not obtained.
Check the object, order the dates, compare the documents, report the encumbrances and refer for professional re-check.
Main outputs
The document list, the sources, the search period and a statement of the missing material.
Abstracts grounded in the original text, the restrictions and the questions needing further handling.
Responsible party
Search staff collect records within the permitted scope, and questions beyond their authority go to the responsible person.
Examiners check the content according to the actual task, and legal confirmation and issuing are allocated according to specific duties.
How they cooperate
Clarify the object and the evidence needed with archive and database staff and the requester.
Check contradictions, restrictions and handling arrangements with lawyers and lending and real estate staff.
Delivery boundaries
A search that finds nothing does not mean there is no encumbrance; the search scope and the deadline must be kept.
A complete abstract does not mean a real transaction is risk-free, and this page does not confirm the legal effect of a document.
Key occupational judgements

These questions are an editorial self-check based on the formal tasks. The object, source, period and authority are judged separately, and real transaction questions should be handled by the corresponding body or professional, not replaced by paper practice.
Do the parcel description in the request and the document found point to the same object?
Is there enough basis to merge parties with the same name into one entity?
Are the document date, the registration date and the search deadline kept apart?
Does the release or correction record clearly relate to the original encumbrance and the same parcel?

First list the original document numbers, the objects and the related items, and keep the contradictions. Taking E1 as an example, the P41 record cannot be used for P14 just because the names are similar; ask the responsible person for the corresponding document and the basis for verification.
Does the definitive tone of the abstract go beyond the search scope and your own authority?

Go back to the original material sentence by sentence and note the search period and the open items; a database returning nothing, automatic text or passing the practice cannot be written as legal advice, a registration conclusion or an insurance commitment.
After receiving a new document, which judgements in the old abstract need updating?
Intake｜clarifying the request and scope｜Read the parcel, parties, record categories and period, and record what is unclear.
Searching｜finding public and private records｜Look up material within the permitted scope, keep the record numbers and sources, and do not extend the use of customer information.
Checking｜examining descriptions and restrictions｜Compare the legal description, rights holders, mortgages and other document conditions, and mark the contradictions.
Abstracts｜organising legal and insurance details｜Keep the original restrictions, periods and sources, and avoid a definitive tone that goes beyond the evidence.
Cooperation｜communicating problems and re-checks｜Give the specific document and the question awaiting confirmation, and hand it to the responsible person.
Updating｜keeping records and versions｜Register newly added material and the basis for changes, and state the search coverage and the items still open.
Section title｜The working environment and working style of title examiners, abstractors and searchers

The work largely involves text, databases and communication with people, and accuracy, sitting and daily time pressure stand out in the official context. The actual on-site, counter or internal examination arrangements are checked with the organisation.

Organisation and location｜The United States definition lists law firms, real estate agencies and title insurance companies as clients; the historical Chinese registration counter sample is an adjacent process proxy, and the two jurisdictions' roles are not merged on that basis. Whether the role serves the public, goes out to search files or works remotely must be checked specifically.

Materials and tools｜Parcel descriptions, maps, legal or insurance documents and search requests are the core material. ONet lists TitlePoint, Data Tree, databases, file management, GIS, ERP, SoftPro and office software; listing names does not mean every organisation uses them, and certainly does not prove that AI is used.

Check the request, permission and scope first, then collect and compare the records. The record list, the abstract and the professional re-check must be traceable to one another, and several documents must not be merged automatically into a single legal conclusion.

Pace and intensity｜The ONet context includes time pressure, repeated checking and the consequences of error. The historical counter sample states adaptability to weekend counter service with compensatory leave; that arrangement applies only to that Shanghai Putuo role and is not generalised into a national overtime requirement.

In communication, state the document number, the object, the period and the question. Clarify missing evidence with the requester or the responsible person so the next reader can separate verified facts, original restrictions and questions awaiting handling.

Re-checking and the chain of responsibility｜Searching, abstracting, registration processing, legal judgement on a transaction and insurance commitments may belong to different roles. A job duty list does not prove that an individual holds every issuing authority; unconfirmed uses and questions are not pushed forward on one's own.

Quality observation｜It can be observed whether sources can be traced back, whether the document objects are consistent, whether the time range is stated and whether revisions have a basis. These are editorial experience standards, not a determination of valid title or of hiring acceptance.

United States 2025 wages, the 2025—2035 employment projection and the typical entry categories
A 2025 Shanghai Putuo comprehensive intake counter historical recruitment; an adjacent process proxy

The 2024 text of the Chinese enquiry measures needs to be read together with the 2025 revision; the enquiry subject, authorisation, scope and conditions of use are checked separately, and the 2026 republication date does not mean the full text is the latest version.

Title examiners, abstractors and searchers search real estate records, check title documents and abstract the relevant legal or insurance details to produce material with stated sources and limits; the actual professional re-check, registration and issuing authority are set by role and jurisdiction.

Paralegals and legal assistants help lawyers investigate facts, prepare legal material and search for legal authority; title records may be one kind of material, but the work of serving lawyers is not limited to title documents.

Appraisers and assessors of real estate estimate real estate value, possibly for tax and other purposes. Market and transaction material is used for valuation, and a value estimate cannot replace a title record examination.

Court, municipal and licence clerks handle the documents, records, information and procedures of the relevant authority. The work includes checking material and serving the public, but the specific processing authority is confirmed with the organisation concerned.
File clerks classify, store and retrieve records for permitted users. Traceable material is the shared foundation, and filing itself is not a professional judgement about title restrictions.

paragraphs: This occupation: record searching and indexing
Search the records relevant to the parcel, parties and period according to the request, and produce a sourced document list with the missing items listed.
The focus is the search scope and the traceability of records; a failed search cannot be written as the absence of an encumbrance.
If you are willing to organise the leads, check the objects and record the dates, you can start with the E1 index; the role's database permissions and training are checked separately.
This occupation: document examination and abstracts
Compare the legal description, rights holders and restrictions in the title documents, and organise the legal or insurance information into an abstract and report the matters needing handling.
The document relationships and restrictions need further checking, and the real legal confirmation, registration processing and issuing authority follow the role's division of duties.
If you are willing to trace the basis sentence by sentence and explain contradictions, you can try an abstract; the practice does not prove that you can handle a real transaction independently.
Paralegals and legal assistants
The legal work of assisting lawyers is broader, and a title search may be only part of a case or transaction file.
If you would rather take part in lawyer support, case material and legal research, you can learn about the training for that direction and the local job requirements.
Appraisers and assessors of real estate
The core purpose is to estimate value; title document work focuses on the object, the record relationships and restriction information.
If you are more interested in market comparison and real estate value estimates, you can check the valuation training and the qualifications in the relevant jurisdiction.
Court, municipal and licence clerks
Documents, records and procedures are handled under the authority's procedures, and the occupational title does not imply title examination or judicial decision authority.
If you prefer public service, counter communication and procedural records, you can check the recruitment and processing duties of the specific body.
File clerks
The focus is classifying, storing, retrieving and tracking records; organising files does not automatically include judging title or legal content.
If you prefer information management and retrieval, you can learn about archive tasks; where a professional title judgement is needed, it still goes to the responsible person.
How do you choose between title material work and the adjacent occupations?

Compare the work objects, the purpose of delivery and the responsibility. The first two lines are task understanding lines within the same occupation, and the last four are separate occupations; these editorial comparisons do not constitute a guarantee of transfer or mutual recognition of qualifications.

First confirm whether you want to deliver a search list, a document abstract, lawyer support material, a valuation result, an authority procedure or an archive record, then check the actual role; shared skills cannot flatten the differences in professional authority.

The basis is five precise O*NET occupational files. The comparisons and choice suggestions are summarised editorially on this page, and do not cite actor occupations, recruitment numbers or unverified job transfer success rates.
Use the E1/E2 document index on this page to observe your own reading and checking habits, then look at a target role's real duties, entry conditions and re-checking arrangements.

At the ability level, generative tools can be tried for raising document checking questions, preparing index drafts and rewriting abstracts. This is an editorial idea, not a verified conclusion about accuracy or efficiency; every parcel, date, related item and restriction must be traced back to the original record.

At the task level, the easier support idea to propose is extracting numbers, dates and objects from given documents and outputting a table with sources. Whether the search is complete, whether the documents concern the same object and whether a release corresponds to the original item require separate verification and cannot be presumed from fluent text.

At the responsibility level, an automatic abstract cannot conjure access permission, professional issuing authority or legal effect out of nothing. The formal tasks of this occupation include reporting restrictions and handling problems, and who re-checks, who issues and what the material may be used for are set by the actual jurisdiction and role.

The Chinese enquiry rules allow eligible rights holders and interested parties, among others, to enquire in accordance with the law and set the boundaries for using the material. Trying AI does not change the identity and authorisation conditions, and real customer material cannot be automatically extended in use because the practice needs it.

The NIST AI RMF1.0 provides a general AI risk management method that can be used to identify reliability, material use, evidence and responsibility problems; it is not a study of title system accuracy, time saved or adoption scale.
The 2025 national employee wage description sets out the original wage distribution and provides no causal estimate of AI use and individual pay; no wage increase or decrease can be derived from it.

The BLS2025—2035 total employment projection does not separate AI causation, and wages, the task support ideas and industry topic signals cannot be merged into a job replacement rate; continue checking the specific tasks and material responsibilities.

At the occupational level, partial indexing or abstract support cannot be used to conclude that the whole occupation will disappear. The total BLS employment projection, the specific task uses and industry discussion must be explained separately, and the current evidence provides no general replacement rate for this occupation.

Insufficient evidence: no verifiable general AI adoption ratio, task accuracy, net job impact or Chinese wage causality research for this occupation was obtained; public activity and software lists provide only limited signals.
How will AI change title material tasks and responsibilities?

Insufficient evidence: the general AI adoption rate, task scores and net employment causal results for this occupation. Index abstracts can serve as a support idea, but the correspondence to the original text, the search coverage and the professional authority still need checking; the BLS2025—2035 overall growth of 2.1%, the ten-year net increase of about 1300 people and the average annual 5300 openings that includes replacements are component indicators, not an AI effect.

The table below uses the precise occupational tasks, the general AI risk framework, the employment projection and the wage method separately. They support different questions, and the risk framework is not treated as a real-world test of title software, nor the employment growth as an AI effect.
O*NET23-2093 tasks and software list
It explains the work objects and the software categories; it provides no AI adoption rate or performance test.
NIST AI RMF1.0 general risk management
Used to discuss reliability, transparency and responsibility arrangements; not an effect study specific to this occupation.
BLS2025—2035 precise occupational employment projection

2025—2035 United States 23-2093 total employment from 59.8 thousand to 61.1 thousand, growth of 2.1% and a ten-year net increase of about 1300 people; an average of 5300 openings a year including replacements, not a yearly net addition, a current hiring number or an independent AI effect.
The total occupational projection does not separate the AI contribution, and openings are not the same as net additions.
O*NET2025 national wages and the BLS wage basis
It describes the occupation's wage distribution, and the year, region, unit and population must be kept consistent.
It does not explain wage changes after AI adoption and does not include self-employment income.
The NIST risk framework and the manual trace-back suggestion
Identify errors, material sensitivity and responsibility problems, and set up a traceable re-check.
A general method cannot provide title examination accuracy, commercial system certification or enquiry permission.
Does an occupational software list prove that AI is already widespread?
No. Database, file management, GIS, ERP and office software names indicate tool categories, without giving the number or proportion of users of AI functions.
Does a general risk framework prove that title abstracts are reliable?
No. The framework supports identifying and managing risk; the specific data, system, task and real business outcomes still need verification.
Does employment growth mean AI has created jobs?
No. The official projection is a total occupational figure and does not separate AI causation; the annual openings also include replacement demand.
Can a wage table predict an individual's pay rise after AI adoption?
Can automation take over title confirmation for me directly?

Tool output cannot be used to presume professional authority. The responsibility for searching, abstracting, registration processing, legal judgement on a transaction and insurance commitments is confirmed by the specific role and jurisdiction.
What do the formal software and task lists show?

O*NET lists databases, file management, GIS and office software and document tasks, showing the tools and work objects; the list provides no AI adoption rate, performance test or job replacement effect.
How can a low-cost trial control errors?
Use only original fictional records, trace the object, date, source and related conditions item by item, keep the revisions and open items, and do not upload real customer material.
Precise occupational file
It defines the search, examination and abstract tasks, the work context and the software categories; it does not prove an AI effect.
General risk management method
The NIST framework supports risk identification, evidence and responsibility arrangements, not a real-world test of title systems.
Precise occupational task scope
O*NET describes finding records and document examination abstracts; the actual professional authority is checked separately.
Formal software and work objects
The O*NET tool list provides no AI adoption rate or effect study.
General risk and verification boundaries
The NIST method does not replace title model performance testing, regulations or independent effect evidence.
Official employment projection
2025—2035 occupational employment and openings, which cannot independently explain AI causation.
General AI risk framework
Discussing risk, evidence and responsibility; not a title-specific assessment or an entry certificate.
Ability: whether a tool can complete one clearly defined text task depends on correspondence to the original text, not on how fluent the output is.
Task: extraction, indexing, relationship checking, professional re-check and issuing are not the same responsibility.
Occupation: partial support does not equal the disappearance of the whole occupation, and employment change must use an independent basis.
Record searching
Clarify the object and period
A tool can draft the questions awaiting confirmation but cannot decide authorisation or the full scope automatically.
Staff check the request, the parcel identifier, the period and the permitted material.
Document index
Extract the number, date and object
A tool can produce an index draft and may misread or omit fields.
Compare with the original text item by item and keep the number sources and the unrecognised items.
Date checking
Distinguish the document date from the search deadline
A tool can sort the dates given, but cannot fill in dates that do not exist or extend the search coverage.
Check the meaning and source of the dates and mark coverage gaps separately.
Relationship checking
Match mortgages and release records
A tool may wrongly merge different parcels because the names are similar.
Check the same object and the explicit relationship separately, and do not release an item on the basis of text similarity.
Abstract handover
Organise legal or insurance details
A tool can draft an abstract but may drop conditions or be over-definite.
Trace every sentence back to the original record and keep the scope, the restrictions and the questions awaiting handling.
Cooperative re-checking
Explain the contradiction to the responsible person
A tool can reword the format of the question but does not take on the professional determination.
State the document number, the point in dispute and the actual re-checking responsibility.
Version updating
Handle newly added documents and corrections
A tool can list the changes, and may mistake local new evidence for full coverage.
Change only the judgements affected and keep the first version, the new evidence and the items still open.
Record searching line
The easier support to propose is field extraction and index drafts, and there is as yet no general performance indicator verified on this page.
The access scope, the trace-back to sources and the search coverage are checked by people.
Document abstract line
A draft abstract from the original text can be tried, but omitted conditions and incorrect relationships affect understanding.
Professional examination and issuing follow the actual duties and are not left to a model to determine.
Jurisdiction and business line
The data systems, enquiry permissions and document effect rules of different organisations cannot be merged.
Local rules, identity authorisation and re-checking arrangements are confirmed separately.
Clarify the request
First record the object, period, purpose and available material; if the permission is unclear, pass it to the responsible person to clarify.
Keep the source
Mark each extract with the document number and source, and text that cannot be traced back is not treated as verified fact.
Check relationships and restrictions
Check the same parcel, the same related item and the dates item by item, and keep the unknown where a corresponding release is unconfirmed.
Refer for professional re-check
Give the contradictions, missing items and the draft to the person actually responsible, and do not treat the practice result as a real legal conclusion.
Keep the revisions
Record the new material, the basis for changes and the period still not covered, so the old abstract is not overwritten without trace.
Wrongly merged objects
Merging the release document for P41 into P14 would invent a released relationship.
Check the parcel and the related item; do not merge on the basis of similar names.
Invented dates or sources
Generating a document number or a record for a period not seen removes the traceable basis of the abstract.
Trace back field by field, and leave missing items explicitly blank or awaiting checking.
Omitted original conditions
The abstract may turn a qualified statement into a comprehensive risk-free conclusion.
Compare the original text with the abstract, and keep the conditions, scope and uncertainty.
Using material beyond its scope
Customer or restricted records enter an unconfirmed use, affecting confidentiality and the boundaries of authorisation.
Check the permitted uses first, and use only fictional material for the practice.
Confusing a partial revision with a complete search
The corresponding D4 record has been supplemented, but this still does not prove that the index coverage for May 2–5 is complete.
Record document relationships and period coverage separately, and request supplementary evidence for each.
First-time explorers
First write the index and abstract by hand using the fictional E1/E2 on this page, then try a tool and trace back item by item.
Record staff who are learning
Practise clarifying the request, tracing sources and stating restrictions, and check the actual business training and re-checking requirements.
Business supervisors
Assess the specific data and task, and set arrangements for manual verification, permission and versions; this page gives no system certification.
Career changers exploring
Compare the target delivery purpose, the professional knowledge and the jurisdictional authority, and do not treat tool proficiency as mutual recognition of qualifications.

Insufficient evidence: the national wage distribution for title examiners, abstractors and searchers in mainland China. The pre-tax annual average of 94,936 yuan for clerical and related personnel in enterprises above the designated size in 2025 covers many categories of personnel including administrative business and administrative affairs; it is used as a broad background for document search and record organisation tasks, not as an official occupational equivalence, a separately listed wage for this occupation, a median or starting pay.

The posting was published on February 12, 2025 and recruited 4 people for the comprehensive intake counter, with an average post-tax monthly wage of about 4,500—5,000 yuan. The contract is labour dispatch, and applications closed on February 23, 2025; the number of places is not four independent employer samples.

The posting required junior college or above, with the relevant major and Shanghai registration experience as preferred conditions, and adaptability to weekend counter service with compensatory leave. It states the conditions of that counter role and does not prove that all title record roles have the same education or working hours.

When comparing a quote, first ask about pre-tax or post-tax, monthly or annual, base wage and bonus, the contract party and overtime arrangements. The historical posting does not list the full composition, so bonuses, training pay or current pay in an open vacancy are not written in on your own.

Wages, qualifications and AI are discussed separately on this page. United States wages are not converted into Chinese take-home income, and the proxy role conditions do not replace national statistics; use a real current recruitment to learn about local requirements.

The United States 2025 national 23-2093 wage table gives both annual and hourly pay. This page adopts the official median annual wage of 58,650 US dollars and the median hourly wage of 28.20 US dollars; both are values published directly in that table, not a private conversion by multiplying hours.

The annual values P10/P25/P50/P75/P90 are 38,170／47,420／58,650／74,810／90,830 US dollars; the corresponding hourly values are 18.35／22.80／28.20／35.97／43.67 US dollars. The percentile points are distribution positions, not promotion grades.
